name: Painting of the Sea
source:
After an attempt on her own life two years ago, Maria has decided to abandon what vestiges remain of her humanity and live in total isolation. Emily wishes to break that isolation for her own gain, by any means necessary.

[From [url=https://dutchduk.itch.io/painting-of-the-sea]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两年前，玛丽亚尝试过自杀，她决定放弃残存的人性，过着完全与世隔绝的生活。艾米丽希望为了自己的利益，不择手段地打破这种孤立。

[来自[url=https://dutchduk.itch.io/painting-of-the-sea]itch.io[/url]]
